podcast.title: Major Player in Hip Hop Subculture
podcast.body: Roc-A-Fella Records was identified as one of the "great record monsters" within the hip hop subculture, indicating its significant influence and power in the industry. "Rocafela Records que era uno de los grandes, monstruos discográficos de toda esta subcultura."

podcast.title: Prevented Kanye West from Signing Elsewhere
podcast.body: The label exerted pressure on Columbia Records, causing them to withdraw an offer to sign Kanye West as an artist. Roc-A-Fella's motivation was to prevent the loss of Kanye West, who was at the time a highly valued and important producer for them. "Columbia Records que finalmente se echaban atrás por la presión de Rocaf y la Records porque no querían perder ese grandísimo productor que era Kenny West."
